title: Vanilla Bean Rice Pudding
summary: Slow-simmered creamy rice pudding full of real vanilla seeds, served warm or chilled.

ingredients.note: or 2 tsp vanilla, stirred in at the end

ingredients.item: pudding rice or short-grain white rice
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Vanilla sugar
steps.text: scrape the vanilla seeds into the sugar and rub together with your fingertips so the seeds spread evenly; keep the pod. Rubbing breaks up the sticky seeds so they spread through the pudding.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.text: boil the water with the salt, add the rice, cover and cook gently 15 min until the water is nearly gone.

steps.title: Cook in milk
steps.text: stir in the milk, cream, vanilla sugar and pod, return to a gentle bubble and cook uncovered, stirring frequently, 30-35 min. Lower the heat and stir every few minutes for another 10-15 min until it is like loose yogurt. Slow cooking lets the rice release starch and thicken the milk.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: remove the pod (rinse and dry it to garnish) and rest 10 min. The pudding sets a little as it rests.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: serve warm, or chill and loosen with a little cold milk; garnish with the pod.

tips: A common mistake is leaving it unstirred; it sticks and burns on the bottom.
A heavy pan spreads the heat and helps prevent scorching.
Loosen chilled pudding with cold milk before serving.
storage: Cool quickly and keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat with a splash of milk until piping hot (74 °C).
